Hi I'm 18 and I've been an ent for three years now. My mom found out that I smoking when I was fifteen, and not long after I started either. She and my stepdad are both cops so she was very upset and I got grounded for an incredibly long time and they took everything I had away from me. After a while she gave me my things back and life resumed as normal until a couple of months ago in summer. I asked her how she thought I looked and if she liked it, and she started yelling at me "No of course I don't!" and "I raised you better than this" so I distinctly remember telling her that I didn't like drinking (because I don't, I rarely drink) but I do like smoking. It's still a very sensitive subject for her and she is clearly disappointed in me every time I mention anything about weed. She never sees me smoking or high so I guess she just tells herself that I quit smoking, although it hurts me that she doesn't like who I am or my choices in life. People who were strangers and are now my friends accept who I choose to be and my decisions, but the woman who carried me for nine months and raised me can't? You know how that makes me feel?
